verse.verse_1: By the angels ranged in ranks.
verse.verse_3: By the angels reciting the praise.
verse.verse_5: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is in- between the twain, and Lord of the easts.
verse.verse_6: Verily We! We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment: the stars.
verse.verse_7: And have placed therein a guard against any Satan froward.
verse.verse_8: They cannot listen to the exalted assembly, and they are darted at from every side.
verse.verse_9: With a driving fusillade, and theirs shall be a torment perpetual;
verse.verse_10: Except him who snatcheth away a word by stealth, and him then pursueth a glowing flame.
verse.verse_11: Ask them thou: are they stronger in structure or those others whom We have created? Verily We! We have created them of a sticky clay.
verse.verse_12: Aye! thou marvellest, and they scoff.
verse.verse_13: And when they are admonished, they receive not admcnition.
verse.verse_14: And when they behold a sign, they turn to scoffing.
verse.verse_15: And they say: this Qur'an is naught but magic manifest.
verse.verse_16: When we have become dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then verily be raised?
verse.verse_18: Say thou: and verily ye; shall then be despicable.
verse.verse_19: It shall be but one shout, lo! they shall be staring.
verse.verse_20: And they will say: Ah! woe be Unto us! this is the Day of Requital.
verse.verse_21: This is the Day of Judgment which ye were wont to belie.
verse.verse_22: Gather together those who did wrong and their comrades and that which they were wont to worship
verse.verse_23: Beside Allah, and lead them on to the path of the Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_24: And stop them; verily they are to be questioned:
verse.verse_25: What aileth you that ye succour not one another?
verse.verse_26: Nay! on that Day they will be entirely submissive.
verse.verse_27: And they will advance toward each other mutually questioning.
verse.verse_28: They will say: verily ye! ye were wont to come Unto us Imposing.
verse.verse_29: They will say: nay! ye yourselves were not believers.
verse.verse_30: And we had over you no authority, but ye were a people exorbitant.
verse.verse_31: So on us hath been justified the sentence of our Lord: verily we are to taste.
verse.verse_32: We seduced you astray; verily we were ourselves the seduced ones.
verse.verse_33: So verily on that Day they all in the torment will be sharers.
verse.verse_34: Verily We! in this wise We deal with the culprits.
verse.verse_35: Verily when it was said Unto them: there is no god but Allah, they ever grew stiff-necked.
verse.verse_36: And they said: are we going to abandon our gods on account of a Poet distracted?
verse.verse_37: Aye! he hath come with the truth, and he confesseth to the sent ones.
verse.verse_38: Verily ye are going to taste a torment afflictive.
verse.verse_39: And ye shall be required not except for that which ye have been doing;
verse.verse_40: But the bondmen of Allah, the sincere ones -
verse.verse_41: Those! theirs shall be a provision known:
verse.verse_42: Fruits! And they shall be honoured.
verse.verse_45: Round shall be passed a cup Unto them filled with limpid drink:
verse.verse_46: White, a pleasure Unto the drinkers.
verse.verse_47: No headiness there shall be therein, nor shall they be therewith Inebriated.
verse.verse_48: And with them shall be damsels of refraining looks, large- eyed
verse.verse_49: As though they were eggs hidden.
verse.verse_50: Then they will advance Unto each other, mutually questioning.
verse.verse_51: And a speaker from among them will say: verily there was Unto me a mate.
verse.verse_52: Who said: art thou of those who confess to the doctrine of Resurrection:
verse.verse_53: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, are we indeed going to be requited?
verse.verse_54: Allah will say: will ye look down?
verse.verse_55: Then he will look down and see him in the midst of the Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_56: And he will say: by Allah, thou hadst wellnigh causedest me to perish.
verse.verse_57: And but for the favourcf my lord, I should have been of those brought forward.
verse.verse_58: Are we not then to die
verse.verse_59: Save our first death, and are we not to be tormented?
verse.verse_60: Verily this! that is the supreme achievement.
verse.verse_61: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
verse.verse_62: Is this better as an entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum?
verse.verse_63: Verily We! We have made it a temptation for the wrong- doers.
verse.verse_64: Verily it is a tree that springeth forth in the bottom of Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_65: The fruit thereof is as though the hoods of the serpents.
verse.verse_66: And verily they must eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
verse.verse_67: And thereafter verily they shall have thereon a draught of balling water.
verse.verse_68: And thereafter verily their return is Unto the Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_69: Verily they found their fathers gone astray.
verse.verse_70: So they in their footsteps are rushing.
verse.verse_71: And assuredly there went stray before them many of the ancients.
verse.verse_72: And assuredly We sent among them warners.
verse.verse_73: So behold what wise hath been the end of those who were warned.
verse.verse_74: Save the bondmen of Allah sincere.
verse.verse_75: And assuredly Nuh cried Unto us; and We are the Best of answerers!
verse.verse_76: And We delivered him and his people from the great affliction.
verse.verse_77: And his offspring! them We made the survivors.
verse.verse_78: And We left for him among the posterity.
verse.verse_79: Peace be on Nuh among the worlds.
verse.verse_80: Verily We! thus We recompense the well-doers.
verse.verse_81: Verily he was of Our bondmen believing.
verse.verse_83: And verily of his sect was Ibrahim.
verse.verse_84: Recall what time he came Unto his lord with a heart whole.
verse.verse_85: Recall what time he said Unto his father and his people: What is it that ye worship?
verse.verse_86: Is it a falsehood-god beside Allah - that ye desire?
verse.verse_87: what, then, is your opinion of the Lord of the worlds?
verse.verse_88: Then he glanced a glance on the stars.
verse.verse_89: And he said: verily I am about to be sick.
verse.verse_90: So they departed from him turning their backs.
verse.verse_91: Then he slipped Unto their gods and said: eat ye not
verse.verse_92: What aileth ye that ye speak not?
verse.verse_93: Then he slipped Unto them striking them with the right hand.
verse.verse_94: Then they advanced toward him, hastening.
verse.verse_95: He said: worship ye that which carve.
verse.verse_96: Whereas Allah hath created you and that which ye make?
verse.verse_97: They said. build for him a building and cast him into the flaming fire.
verse.verse_98: And they devised a plot for him, but We made them the humble.
verse.verse_99: And he said: verily I am going to my Lord who will guide me.
verse.verse_100: My Lord! Bestow on me a son who will be of the righteous.
verse.verse_101: Wherefore We gave him the glad tidings of a boy gentle.
verse.verse_102: And when he attained the age of, running with him, he said: O my son! verily I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering thee; so look, what considerest thou? He said: O my father! do that which thou art commanded; thou shalt find me, Allah willing, of the patients.
verse.verse_103: Then when the twain had submitted themselves and he had prostrated him upon his temple.
verse.verse_104: We cried Unto him: O Ibrahim
verse.verse_105: Of a surety thou hast fulfilled the vision. Verily We! thus We recompense the well-doers.
verse.verse_106: Verily that! that was a trial manifest.
verse.verse_107: And We ransomed him with a mighty victim.
verse.verse_108: And We left for him among the posterity:
verse.verse_110: Verily We! thus We compense the well-doers.
verse.verse_111: Verily he was one of Our believing bondmen.
verse.verse_112: And We gave him the glad tidings of Is-haq, a prophet, and of the righteous.
verse.verse_113: And We blessed him and Is-haq; and of their offspring are some well-doers and some who wrong themselves manifestly.
verse.verse_114: And assuredly We gave grace Unto Musa and Harun.
verse.verse_115: And delivered them and their people from the great affliction.
verse.verse_116: And We succoured them so that they became overcomers.
verse.verse_117: And We vouchsafed Unto the twain a Book luminous.
verse.verse_118: And We led the twain on Unto the straight path.
verse.verse_119: And We left for the twain among the posterity:
verse.verse_120: Peace be Unto Musa and Harun.
verse.verse_121: Verily We! thus We recompense the well-doers.
verse.verse_122: Verily the twain were of Our bondmen believing.
verse.verse_123: And verily, llyas was one of the sent ones.
verse.verse_124: Recall what time he said Unto his people: fear ye not?
verse.verse_125: Call ye upon Bal and forsake the Best of creators.
verse.verse_126: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
verse.verse_127: Then they belied him, so verily they are to be brought up.
verse.verse_128: Except the bondmen of Allah sincere.
verse.verse_129: And We left for him among the posterity:
verse.verse_131: Verily We! thus We recompense the well-doers.
verse.verse_132: Verily he was one of Our bondmen believing.
verse.verse_133: And verily Lut was of the sent ones.
verse.verse_134: Recall what time We delivered him and his household, all.
verse.verse_135: Save an old woman among the lingerers.
verse.verse_137: And surely ye pass by them in the morning.
verse.verse_138: And at night. Will ye not therefore reflect?
verse.verse_139: And verily Yunus was Of the sent ones.
verse.verse_140: Recall what time he ran away Unto a laden ship.
verse.verse_141: Then he joined the lots, and was of the condemned.
verse.verse_142: And a fish swallowed him, and he was reproaching himself.
verse.verse_143: And had he not been of those who hallow Him,
verse.verse_144: He would have tarried in the belly thereof till the Day when they are raised.
verse.verse_145: Then We cast him on a bare desert whilst he was sick.
verse.verse_146: And We caused to grow over him a tree, a gourd.
verse.verse_147: And We had sent him to a hundred thousand: rather they exceeded.
verse.verse_148: And they believed, whrefore We let them enjoy life for a season.
verse.verse_149: Now ask thou them: there for thy Lord daughters and for them sons?
verse.verse_150: Or created We the angels females while they were witnesses?
verse.verse_151: Lo! verily it is of their falsehood that they say:
verse.verse_152: God hath begotten. Verily they are the liars.
verse.verse_153: Hath He chosen daughters above sons?
verse.verse_154: What aileth you? How judge ye?
verse.verse_155: Will ye not then be admonished?
verse.verse_156: Or, is there for you a clear warranty
verse.verse_157: Then bring your book, if ye say sooth.
verse.verse_158: And they have made a kinship between Him and the jinn a kinship whereas the jinn assuredly know that they are to be brought up
verse.verse_159: Hallowed be Allah from that which they ascribe to Him.
verse.verse_160: Except the bondmen of Allah sincere.
verse.verse_161: Wherefore verily neither ye nor that which ye worship,
verse.verse_162: Can tempt anyone to rebel against Him.
verse.verse_163: Save him Who is to roast in the Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_164: Of us there is none but hath a station assigned.
verse.verse_165: And verily we! we are ranged in ranks.
verse.verse_167: And they surely were wont to say:
verse.verse_168: Had we but an admonition as had the ancients.
verse.verse_169: Surefy we would have been the bondmen of God sincere.
verse.verse_170: Yet they disbelieve therein. Presently they shall come to know.
verse.verse_171: And assuredly Our word hath already gone forth Our bondmen, the sent ones:
verse.verse_172: That verily they! they shall be made triumphant.
verse.verse_173: And verily Our host! they are to be overcome.
verse.verse_174: So turn thou aside from them for a season.
verse.verse_175: And see them thou; they themselves shall presently see.
verse.verse_176: Our torment seek they to hasten on!
verse.verse_177: Then when it descendeth Unto them face to, face, a hapless morn that shall be for those who were Warned.
verse.verse_178: And turn thou aside from them for a season.
verse.verse_179: And see thou: they themselves shall presently see.
verse.verse_180: Hallowed be thine Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they ascribe!
verse.verse_181: And peace be Unto the sent ones.
verse.verse_182: And all praise Unto Allah the Lord of the worlds.
